decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through removal spells and graveyard hate while also generating value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The main win condition is to control the board with creatures like Crypt Rats and Troll of Khazad-dûm, while also using Avenging Hunter as a finisher. The lands in the deck provide a mix of color fixing and token generation, allowing for flexibility in the mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition and resource management.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Balustrade Spy combo to mill the entire library and then win the game through various means such as generating a large amount of mana with creatures like Overgrown Battlement and Saruli Caretaker, or using Dread Return to bring back powerful creatures like Lotleth Giant. The deck also includes cards like Avenging Hunter and Sagu Wildling to put pressure on the opponent while setting up the combo. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently execute the combo while maintaining board presence and resources.

The deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while simultaneously maximizing mana efficiency. By utilizing a combination of creature removal, protection spells, and mana ramp, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and gradually gain advantage. The Gates serve as a key component in both fixing mana for consistency and providing additional benefits through their abilities. By effectively managing resources and controlling the pace of the game, the deck seeks to establish dominance and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with artifact creatures and utilize cards like Galvanic Blast and Makeshift Munitions to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw spells like Thoughtcast to ensure a consistent flow of threats. Nihil Spellbomb is included to disrupt the opponent's graveyard strategies. By efficiently playing out artifacts and utilizing their abilities, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of various spells and creatures, with a focus on recurring key cards using Ephemerate and Archaeomancer. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and board control by utilizing bounce and counterspells, while also generating card advantage through the drawing power of cards like Preordain and Mulldrifter. The deck includes efficient removal spells and card draw engines to outvalue opponents and ultimately win through incremental advantage.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan. It focuses on countering spells, removing creatures, and generating card advantage through effects like Brainstorm and Lórien Revealed. Additionally, the deck features evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite to provide pressure and card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Bojuka Bog and Suffocating Fumes to disrupt graveyard strategies. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and out-control the opponent to secure victory.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins archetype focuses on quickly deploying efficient creatures and burning the opponent with direct damage spells to overwhelm them before they can stabilize. Utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, along with powerful creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Goblin Bushwhacker, this deck aims to push through damage and finish off the opponent with cards like Fireblast. The goal is to establish early board presence and burn the opponent out before they can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate large amounts of mana and play powerful spells. It utilizes control elements such as Maelstrom Colossus, Bramble Wurm, and Pinnacle Kill-Ship to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence. The deck also includes card draw and ramp spells like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to consistently find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big creatures and powerful spells once the Urzatron lands are online.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, evasive creatures like Faeries and Ninjas to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while countering their spells and disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of card draw spells like Of One Mind and creatures like Thalakos Seer help maintain card advantage and consistency. The deck also features disruptive spells like Cryoshatter and Sewer-veillance Cam to control the board and protect its attacking creatures. Overall, the Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and control.

The deck focuses on consistently dealing damage to the opponent through a combination of direct damage spells and creatures with abilities that trigger when spells are cast. The goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total using cheap and efficient burn spells, while also leveraging creatures like Sneaky Snacker and Guttersnipe to further pressure the opponent and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Grab the Prize and Voldaren Epicure provide additional opportunities to deal damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless onslaught of burn and aggression.

This deck focuses on using defender creatures to generate a significant amount of mana and then using a combination of cards like Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist to create an infinite mana loop. With this combo in place, the deck can quickly ramp up to play powerful creatures or spells. The deck also includes ways to tutor for key combo pieces and generate card advantage with cards like Lead the Stampede and Winding Way. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently using defender creatures to create a game-winning combo.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Cast Down and Eviscerator's Insight to remove any threats from the opponent. Additionally, the deck features card advantage engines like Thraben Inspector and Refurbished Familiar to maintain a steady stream of resources. With a mix of creature aggression, removal spells, and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory in a swift manner.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize mana acceleration from cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl to quickly ramp up to big threats like Avenging Hunter and Annoyed Altisaur. Writhing Chrysalis and Boarding Party provide additional aggression, while Thermokarst and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan by destroying their lands. It is a fast-paced and aggressive deck that aims to win the game quickly through consistent pressure and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana, allowing for powerful late-game plays such as casting big creatures like Maelstrom Colossus and Ulamog's Crusher. The deck also includes control elements like Bonder's Ornament and Crop Rotation to help manage the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by ramping into and casting strong threats while maintaining control of the game.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly amass artifacts on the battlefield to power up cards like Galvanic Blast and Myr Enforcer for aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Thoughtcast and Refurbished Familiar, it aims to draw cards efficiently and maintain a steady flow of resources. The inclusion of Kenku Artificer helps to pump up the power of the artifacts on the battlefield, while also providing disruption with cards like Cast Down and Nihil Spellbomb. Overall, the deck focuses on leveraging artifacts to overwhelm opponents and push for a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Crypt Rats to control the board, while also utilizing sacrifice effects from cards like Fanatical Offering and Defile to gain advantage. The deck also includes graveyard hate with cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Bojuka Bog, as well as card draw and lifegain with Ichor Wellspring and Lembas. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently trading resources and disrupting their game plan.
